progress.message: Picked up by the Blender worker

request: Skullbasher Rusher: Charge! Moves and attacks in the same turn. All forward momentum. He holds a mace in his right hand and a shield in his left hand; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Shield bash then mace swing: lunges forward behind the shield (first impact), then swings the mace down ('hit' at the mace impact).
